prompts.corner_sw_v2: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated modular 2.5D pixel-art architectural corner for underground cyberpunk maintenance safehouse. Orthographic top-down cutaway RPG camera above and slightly south, floor plan axes horizontal and vertical. Charcoal steel and slate concrete, crisp pixel clusters, restrained wear, broad visible gray TOP CAP and short dark exterior front face along bottom. Genuine transparent background. NO floor, room, character, text, perspective diagonals or scene. Low foreground parapet, not a tall rear wall. Compact L corner; vertical leg and horizontal leg equal short lengths. The entire asset should occupy a compact 32 by 28 logical game pixel footprint. Consistent upper-left light. SOUTHWEST lower-left corner: west wall leg extends UP along LEFT edge; south parapet leg extends RIGHT along BOTTOM edge. Empty room interior is UPPER RIGHT. Broad top cap makes L silhouette. Straight attachment edges at top and right.
